metadata.description: Timeline showing the progression of the payment service incident

data.diagram:
gantt
    title Payment Service Incident Timeline
    dateFormat HH:mm:ss
    axisFormat %H:%M:%S
    
    section Normal Operation
    Service Healthy           :done, healthy, 16:00:00, 10m
    
    section Performance Degradation
    CPU Usage Rising          :active, cpu, 16:10:00, 5m
    Memory Pressure           :active, mem, 16:10:00, 5m
    DB Connection Pool High   :active, pool, 16:10:00, 5m
    
    section Incident Start
    First DB Timeout          :crit, timeout1, 16:10:15, 5s
    Retry Failed              :crit, retry, 16:10:18, 2s
    Connection Pool Exhausted :crit, exhaust, 16:10:23, 2s
    Circuit Breaker Opens     :crit, cb_open, 16:10:25, 20s
    
    section Impact
    Payment Requests Failing  :crit, failures, 16:10:15, 30s
    Health Check Failed       :crit, health, 16:10:28, 17s
    
    section Recovery Attempts
    Connection Pool Reset Attempt :active, reset1, 16:10:32, 3s
    Emergency GC Triggered    :active, gc, 16:10:38, 2s
    
    section Recovery
    DB Connection Restored    :done, db_up, 16:10:45, 1s
    Circuit Breaker Half-Open :active, cb_half, 16:10:45, 5s
    Test Requests Succeed     :done, test, 16:10:48, 2s
    Circuit Breaker Closed    :done, cb_close, 16:10:50, 1s
    
    section Post-Recovery
    Service Stabilizing       :active, stable, 16:10:51, 9s
    Full Recovery Confirmed   :milestone, recovery, 16:11:00, 0s
    Normal Operation Resumed  :done, normal, 16:11:00, 5m
